summary.name: OBS Studio
summary.one_liner: OBS Studio is free, open source software for video recording and live streaming on Windows, Mac and Linux.
use_cases: live streaming to Twitch or YouTube
recording local videos in high quality
mixing multiple scenes with webcams and window captures
switching scenes with custom transitions during a broadcast
previewing scenes before going live with Studio Mode
monitoring several scenes at once in Multiview
summary.what_it_does: OBS Studio captures and mixes video and audio in real time from sources such as window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams and capture cards. Users can build an unlimited number of scenes and switch between them with custom transitions or stinger videos. The audio mixer offers per-source filters like noise gate, noise suppression and gain, plus VST plugin support. Studio Mode previews scenes before they go live, and Multiview shows up to 8 scenes at once. A plugin and scripting API supports native plugins and Lua or Python scripts.
notable: Studio Mode for previewing scenes before they go live
Multiview monitors up to 8 scenes at once
Lua and Python scripting plus native plugin API
VST plugin support in the audio mixer
caveats: Page does not state platform-specific limits beyond naming Windows, Mac and Linux
Latest release listed as 33.0.0 (October 23rd), with no year shown on the page
